name: TEST 3 — Triggers (buttons)
description: Proves trigger mapping works. Send any value greater than 0.5 to fire the button. The effect should be instantaneous and visible.

mappings._section: Send any value > 0.5 to fire. Values <= 0.5 are ignored (button release).

mappings.note: EXPECTED: Glitch pattern randomises instantly. Send 1.0 repeatedly — pattern should change each time.
EXPECTED: Feedback motion resets to centre (fbX, fbY, fbZ, fbTheta snap back to defaults).
